**Finding submitted: T4C — missing (preferred target).**

- **What's there:** Section 9 offers only for-cause (9.1), insolvency (9.2) and incident-based (9.3) termination; 8.1 locks a three-year term with 180-day non-renewal notice on twelve-month Order Form renewals (8.2). Adjacent exits (6.2 acceptance failure, 19.4 warranty, 20.5 infringement, 27.3 force majeure) are all conditional, not convenience.
- **Gap:** No Customer convenience right in a multi-year term — a high-severity deviation under the rule.
- **Cure (one insertion, new 9.4):** Customer convenience termination of the Agreement or any Order Form on thirty days' written notice, plus an express bar on Vendor convenience termination during a committed term.
- **Not restated:** the pro-rata refund element is already met verbatim by Section 10.2 ("Vendor shall refund prepaid recurring Fees covering the period after termination"), so no duplicate refund language was added; no "in whole or in part" or ancillary tails were introduced.
